Attackers could abuse DSRM account to maintain their persistence and access to the organization's Active Directory. If the \"DsrmAdminLogonBehavior\" value is set to \"0\", the administrator account can only be used if the DC starts in DSRM. If the \"DsrmAdminLogonBehavior\" value is set to \"1\", the administrator account can only be used if the local AD DS service is stopped. You can also use other repo, e.g. https://github.com/Neo23x0/sysmon-config, https://github.com/olafhartong/sysmon-modular. How to test detection?
